title.en: Mixture of experts: sparse computation and balancing
title.zh: 专家混合：稀疏计算与平衡

en.a: A dense FFN spends parameters on every token; MoE keeps many expert parameters but routes each token through only a few, creating a routing and communication defect.
en.b: The next-token distribution is still a mixture of expert transformations conditioned on the prefix. The router changes which transformations are active; balancing changes the training signal or the external selection bias.

zh.a: 稠密前馈网络为每个 token 分配参数；MoE 保留大量专家参数，但仅将每个 token 路由到少数几个专家，从而产生路由和通信缺陷。
zh.b: 下一个 token 的分布仍然是基于前缀条件的专家变换混合体。路由器改变哪些变换处于激活状态；平衡则改变训练信号或外部选择偏差。
